INPUTS_JSON: {"operation":"command","mode":"sync","timeout_minutes":"10","workdir":"/opt/madworld","command":"set -u; printf '%s\\n' SCHEMA_AUDIT_START; date -u +%FT%TZ; hostname; id -u; printf '%s\\n' --DEPLOYED--; cat /opt/madworld/.github-deployed-sha 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s\\n' --ENV_PRESENCE--; for k in MADWORLD_DATABASE_URL POSTGRES_USER POSTGRES_DB POSTGRES_PASSWORD DB_HOST_PORT; do if grep -qE \"^${k}=\" .env 2>/dev/null; then echo ${k}=set-in-dotenv; else echo ${k}=absent-from-dotenv; fi; done; printf '%s\\n' --COMPOSE_PS--; docker compose --env-file .env -f ops/docker-compose.production.yml -f ops/docker-compose.deploy.yml ps 2>&1 || true; printf '%s\\n' --CONTAINER_INSPECT--; docker inspect madworld-postgres-1 --format '{{json .Config.Env}}' 2>&1 || true; printf '%s\\n' --ABUSE_TABLES--; timeout 20 docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U \"${POSTGRES_USER:-madworld}\" -d \"${POSTGRES_DB:-madworld_db}\" -Atc \"SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename LIKE 'abuse_control_%' ORDER BY tablename;\" 2>&1 || true; printf '%s\\n' --SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS--; timeout 20 docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U \"${POSTGRES_USER:-madworld}\" -d \"${POSTGRES_DB:-madworld_db}\" -Atc \"SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='schema_migrations';\" 2>&1 || true; printf '%s\\n' --MIGRATION_COUNT--; timeout 20 docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U \"${POSTGRES_USER:-madworld}\" -d \"${POSTGRES_DB:-madworld_db}\" -Atc \"SELECT count(*) FROM schema_migrations;\" 2>&1 || true; printf '%s\\n' SCHEMA_AUDIT_DONE"}
